label: locate-host-checkvintf
command: import urllib.request,json,pathlib; u="https://api.github.com/repos/LineageOS/android_prebuilts_build-tools/contents/linux-x86/bin?ref=lineage-22.2"; d=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(u)); rows=[{"name":x["name"],"download_url":x.get("download_url")} for x in d]; pathlib.Path("research/host-tools-index.json").write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)); print([x for x in rows if "vintf" in x["name"] or "assemble" in x["name"]])
